newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close at record high.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close at record high.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed at a record high on Tuesday, led by paints and packaging company Corimon SACA, traders and analysts said.
The bolsa's 19-share index rose 1.22 percent to end at 7,743.88 points as 67 million shares worth 6.3 billion bolivars ($13 million) changed hands, according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
For the IBC index, "7,769.03 should be the new target for the current advance," analysts at New York-based IDEA said in a technical commentary.
"If the market is repelled sharply from this level it is likely to ... fall back....If the market has only a mild reaction, the IBC should steepen its rate of ascent over the medium term," IDEA said.
Shares of Corimon led gainers, closing up more than six percent at 12.70 and 17.00 bolivars, respectively.
Among issues that were traded, 28 rose, seven fell and nine closed flat.
"The market is still quite busy and volume, although less than recently, shows continuing signs of investor interest," said Interacciones broker Freddy Zambrano.
Other traders said the market would probably dip shortly on profit-taking, after rising over 22 percent since the beginning of May.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, closed 1.19 percent ahead at 120.64 points.
